whyItMatters: A Slack token in version control gives anyone with repository access the token's full scopes — reading channels, posting messages, or managing the workspace — until it is revoked.
actions: Revoke the token in the Slack admin console and audit what it accessed.
Replace it with a token stored outside version control (secret manager or CI secret).
Rewrite repository history only if policy requires it; revocation is the fix that matters.
verification: The token is revoked and no live Slack token remains in the repository.
